legal_privacy_intro: Plinth collects only the information needed to provide the service. This page explains what we collect, how we use it, and what you can do.
legal_privacy_data_account: Account: your email address (email sign-in), or your Google account's name, email address and profile picture (Google sign-in). A guest trial only creates an anonymous account.
legal_privacy_data_projects: Designs: the design data you create and every past version, comments, and your conversations with the agent.
legal_privacy_data_keys: Model keys: the model API keys you add are encrypted with AES-GCM before being stored, decrypted only when the server forwards a request, and never returned to the browser.
legal_privacy_data_usage: Usage: the number of tokens in each model call, recorded per person and per design so the design's owner can review it.
legal_privacy_data_logs: Operational logs: IP addresses are used for rate limiting and abuse prevention, and error logs for troubleshooting; they are not used for any other purpose.
legal_privacy_flow_llm: When you chat with the agent, the conversation and a summary of the design are sent to the model provider you choose (such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or OpenRouter) and handled under that provider's privacy policy.
legal_privacy_flow_hosting: The service is hosted on Cloudflare; sign-in code emails are sent through an email service provider.
legal_privacy_flow_no_sale: We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.
legal_privacy_rights_export: In “Settings → Account” you can export all of your data (JSON), or delete your account and all designs you own.
legal_privacy_rights_owner: A design's owner can revoke share links, remove members, and delete model keys at any time.
legal_terms_intro: By using Plinth, you agree to the following terms.
legal_terms_reference_p: The designs, areas and analyses produced by Plinth and its agent are meant for discussion and refinement. They are not design drawings and must not be used as a basis for construction. Anything involving structure, fire safety, sunlight spacing, planning approval and the like must be reviewed by a qualified professional. The agent marks such content as “needs professional review”, but cannot guarantee it catches every case.
legal_terms_content_p: Your designs and comments belong to you. You authorize us to store, process and display this content in order to provide the service (including sending it to the model provider you choose). You control who can access your share links.
legal_terms_llm_p: The agent uses model keys that you add yourself; call charges are settled between you and the model provider. Once you share a design with members who can edit, their conversations with the agent also use the key configured for that design. You can change or revoke it at any time.
legal_terms_use_p: You may not use the service for unlawful purposes, attack the service, or circumvent rate limits. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
legal_terms_changes_p: The service may be updated or adjusted. Significant changes will be announced on the website in advance; you can export your data at any time.

settings_models_description: The agent uses your own model keys. Save a provider's key, add the models you want to use with it, and pick a default: designs use it unless you pin another model under “Share”, and you can switch models while chatting. When you share with family who can edit, they can chat with the agent using that design's model too, and usage is recorded under each person's name.
settings_delete_key_description: Models using this key are deleted too; designs pinned to them switch to your default model.
settings_autonomy_note: Deleting a level, sharing outside, and anything that costs money always need your OK first.
settings_delete_account_description: All your designs, versions, comments and model keys will be deleted and can't be recovered. We suggest exporting your data first.
home_step_1_body: How many people, how many rooms, what you like. Or click a wall on the plan and say “move this wall half a meter east”.
home_step_2_title: The agent draws and checks its work
home_step_2_body: It edits the design data directly: walls, doors & windows, rooms, furniture. Then it checks for overlapping rooms, door swings and areas, and points out what changed.
home_step_3_body: Send family one link: they can see the plan and 3D and comment on walls. Every version is kept, so you can roll back anytime.
home_point_1: Room sizes and before/after differences, calculated automatically
home_point_2: Requests like “door centered in the room” or “elder's room about 12 m²” are remembered and kept when other things change
home_point_3: Structural and fire-safety changes are marked “needs professional review” — it won't decide those for you
home_point_4: Uses your own model key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or Chinese models via OpenRouter
home_title: House designs you change by just talking
home_intro: You set the brief and make the calls; the built-in agent does the drafting: drawing walls and windows, laying out rooms, calculating areas and checking its own work. No need to know coordinates, wall thicknesses or CAD software.
home_no_sign_up: No sign-up needed to try it.
home_sign_in_after: to keep your designs in your account.
